image_description: A close-up, high-angle shot of a tabby cat sleeping on its back on a white windowsill. The cat's head is tilted back, eyes closed, with one paw tucked near its face and another extended. Sunlight streams through blinds, creating strong contrast and shadows. A small white object (possibly a bottle cap or toy) is visible in the foreground.
